# agora

`agora` is this repository's one command line. Its audience is `public`. It calls no AI model, never commits or pushes, and keeps no record but Git: a command that records or generates writes tracked files and leaves the commit to a person.

## How to call it

- `agora <noun> <verb> [ID] [--options]`; the ID is the first word after the verb. Verbs: `list`, `show`, `status`, `check`, `build`, `generate`, `add`, `set`, `record`, `new`, `advance`, `publish`, `serve`, `test`.
- Repository-wide commands take no noun: `check`, `context`, `doctor`, `fresh`, `help`, `lock`, `test`.
- `--json` on any command gives one JSON document `{schema, audience, kind, id, data, links, actions}`; `links` and `actions` say what to run next. A failure is a resource of kind `error` with a stable `code` and the actions to take next.
- Exit status: 0 success; 1 it ran and what it checked failed; 2 usage or an invalid argument; 3 a missing package, program or offline prerequisite.
- `--dry-run` on any command that writes shows what it would change and writes nothing. Run it first.
- `agora context RESOURCE` (for example `agora context spec:0020`) returns what you need to work on one resource: the resource, the specs and requirements that govern it, its links, its actions and its files, bounded, saying what it left out.
- `agora command list` and `agora command show COMMAND` read the registry itself; `agora --help` shows the shape.

## What you may do, by category

| Category | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `read` | changes nothing |
| `check` | verifies, and changes nothing tracked |
| `record` | appends a fact to the tracked record |
| `build` | writes derived output that is not itself the record |
| `generate` | rewrites tracked generated files |
| `decision` | changes what only a person decides: for a person, in the terminal or the editor; never over MCP |
| `setup` | changes the clone's own environment (a lock, a fetched toolchain entry, a running server) |

A `decision` command is for a person: `ink record`, `proposal advance`, `spec set`. Do not run one for a person. To ask for a decision, draft it with `agora proposal new RESOURCE --reason TEXT --run COMMAND --field NAME=VALUE`; a person reviews it and runs `agora proposal advance ID`. A proposal is a tracked file under `.agora/proposals/`.

### Arguments and options

- `brand generate`
  - `brand` (BRAND, optional): the brand; every brand when none is named
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `brand show`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
- `check`
  - `sections` (SECTION, zero or more): the sections to run; every section when none and no suite is named
  - `--scope` (TEXT): limit a section that supports it to one resource; the item checks take it more than once
  - `--suite` (SUITE): run a named set of sections
  - `--changed` (flag): run only sections whose watched paths changed
  - `--since` (TEXT): with --changed, also what differs from this Git commit
  - `--runner` (RUNNER): design-systems: browser or python; extension: node or vscode
  - `--brand` (BRAND): design-systems: one brand
  - `--paragon` (TEXT): openedx: Paragon's CLI, to rebuild dist/ (PARAGON in the environment otherwise)
  - `--mode` (VOICE_MODE): voice: sweep as prose or as a procedure (prose by default)
  - `--draft` (flag): voice: report every failure as a warning
  - `--spoken` (flag): voice: sweep as a script to be spoken, with the spoken voice's patterns too
- `command list`
  - `--category` (CATEGORY): only this category
- `command show`
  - `command` (COMMAND): the command's words
- `context`
  - `resource` (RESOURCE): kind:id, such as spec:0020 or requirement:0020/FR-013
- `course build`
  - `path` (PATH): the course's directory
  - `--target` (COURSE_TARGET, required): web, olx or cmi5
  - `--out` (TEXT, required): web: the directory; olx: the .tar.gz; cmi5: the .zip
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--org` (TEXT): olx: the Open edX organization code
  - `--iri` (TEXT): cmi5: the https IRI every cmi5 id is under
  - `--publisher` (TEXT): web, cmi5: the lockup's alternative text (Intellectual Frontiers by default)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `course show`
  - `path` (PATH): the course's directory (named for its id, holding course.adoc)
- `deck build`
  - `path` (PATH): the deck's Markdown file
  - `--out` (TEXT): the HTML file to write; the deck's name with .html beside it by default
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--inline` (flag): embed the stylesheet, script, fonts and images, so the one file stands alone
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `decoration generate`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--only` (KIT_PART): only trace (the lockup and icon) or only set (the wordmark and unit marks)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `decoration show`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--measure` (flag): measure each SVG's finest detail again (slow)
- `design-system list`
  - `--kind` (KIND): only design systems of this kind
- `design-system new`
  - `slug` (SLUG): the design system's slug, ending with its kind's code
  - `--kind` (KIND, required): its kind: the ontology entry's, and the code its slug ends with
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `design-system show`
  - `design_system` (DESIGN_SYSTEM): the design system
- `docs build`
  - `--out` (TEXT): the folder to write; build/docs in this clone when none is named
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `docs generate`
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `email build`
  - `path` (PATH): the message's Markdown file
  - `--out` (TEXT): the HTML file to write, and its .txt beside it; the message's name with .html by default
  - `--assets` (TEXT, required): the public https URL the brand's files (its logos/) are served from
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `extension build`
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `extension test`
  - `--suite` (TEXT): the directory of the tests: an index.js that exports run(), as tools/if-console/test/vscode/suite does
  - `--screenshots` (TEXT): instead of a suite, open the extension's views and a resource page, Learn and a dry-run diff in Dark+, Light+ and High Contrast and write a PNG of each to this folder
  - `--workspace` (TEXT): a folder to add to the workspace after this clone; repeatable, as NAME=PATH or PATH
  - `--report` (TEXT): also write every test's name, status and seconds to this JSON file
- `figure build`
  - `path` (PATH): the figure's SVG source
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--variant` (VARIANT): default, on-dark or grayscale (default by default)
  - `--embed-fonts` (flag): embed the sans, cut to the letters the figure uses, for a page that shows it as an image
  - `--out` (TEXT): the SVG to write; without it the themed SVG is the command's output and nothing is written
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `figure generate`
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `fresh`
  - `generators` (GENERATOR, zero or more): the generators to prove; every one when none is named
  - `--changed` (flag): prove only generators whose sources or outputs changed
- `help`
  - `topic` (TOPIC, optional): the topic; the topics are listed when none is named
- `imagery add`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--master` (TEXT, required): the approved PNG; its file name without .png is the piece's id
  - `--name` (TEXT, required): a short human name
  - `--environment` (TEXT, required): one of the catalog's environments
  - `--description` (TEXT, required): what is drawn, foreground to horizon
  - `--visual-anchor` (TEXT, required): the one built thing the eye lands on
  - `--route` (TEXT, required): how people move through the scene
  - `--built-structure` (TEXT): a human-made thing in the scene (repeat)
  - `--infrastructure-type` (TEXT): the kind of system the structures form (repeat)
  - `--colored-element` (TEXT): what carries color (repeat)
  - `--water-form` (TEXT): the form water takes; omit when there is none
  - `--metaphor` (TEXT): what the piece can stand for (repeat)
  - `--suggested-subject` (TEXT): a subject the metaphors suit (repeat)
  - `--supplied` (DATE): when the piece was supplied; today by default
  - `--generator` (TEXT, required): what made it
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `imagery build`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `imagery list`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
- `imagery show`
  - `piece` (PIECE): the piece, as <brand>/<piece>
- `ink list`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
- `ink record`
  - `ink` (INK): the ink, as <brand>/<role>
  - `--spot` (TEXT, required): the spot color's name as checked
  - `--thread` (TEXT, required): the thread's number as checked
  - `--by` (TEXT, required): who checked them: the one name a command writes to a tracked file (0042 FR-012)
  - `--on` (DATE, required): the date they were checked
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `ink show`
  - `ink` (INK): the ink, as <brand>/<role>

- `layout build`
  - `layout` (LAYOUT): the layout, by name or alias
  - `--out` (TEXT, required): the file to write
  - `--typeface` (TEXT): the typeface set to use instead of the layout's own
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `layout show`
  - `layout` (LAYOUT): the layout, by name or alias
  - `--def` (flag): also give the iflayout.def the document class reads (a layout that is built)
  - `--typeface` (TEXT): with --def: the typeface set to use instead of the layout's own
- `lock`
  - `group` (GROUP, optional): the group; every group that pins packages when none is named
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `mcp serve`

  - `job` (PATH): the job's JSON file
  - `--out` (TEXT): the PNG to write; the job's name with .png beside it by default
  - `--svg` (TEXT): also write the SVG the PNG is rendered from
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `openedx build`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--paragon` (TEXT): Paragon's CLI of your own, such as node_modules/.bin/paragon (the npm lock's is used otherwise)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `openedx generate`
  - `brand` (BRAND): the brand
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `proposal advance`
  - `proposal` (PROPOSAL): the open proposal
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `proposal list`
  - `--status` (PROPOSAL_STATUS): only open or only accepted proposals
- `proposal new`
  - `resource` (RESOURCE): the resource it concerns, as kind:id
  - `--reason` (TEXT, required): why the change is proposed
  - `--run` (COMMAND, required): the record, generate or decision command to replay, as `command list` shows it
  - `--field` (TEXT): a field of that command as NAME=VALUE, once for each; a name given twice is a list
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `proposal show`
  - `proposal` (PROPOSAL): the proposal
- `requirement add`
  - `requirement` (REQUIREMENT): the requirement
  - `--control` (CONTROL, required): <catalog>:<control>
  - `--note` (TEXT): what the row says in its own words
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `requirement list`
  - `--spec` (SPEC): only this spec's requirements
  - `--mechanism` (MECHANISM): only requirements enforced this way (none lists what nothing enforces)
- `requirement set`
  - `requirement` (REQUIREMENT): the requirement
  - `--mechanism` (MECHANISM, required): check, gate, review or none
  - `--by` (TEXT): '<repository>: <command>' for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, '-' for none
  - `--note` (TEXT): what the row says in its own words
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `requirement show`
  - `requirement` (REQUIREMENT): the requirement
- `sign build`
  - `job` (PATH): the job's JSON file
  - `--out` (TEXT): the PDF to write; the job's name with .pdf beside it by default
  - `--brand` (BRAND): the brand that themes it (frontiers-brand by default)
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `skill generate`
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `spec list`
  - `--status` (SPEC_STATUS): only specs in this status
- `spec new`
  - `slug` (SLUG): the spec's slug; its number is the next unused one
  - `--title` (TEXT): the spec's title; the slug's words by default
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `spec set`
  - `spec` (SPEC): the spec
  - `--status` (SPEC_STATUS, required): the new status
  - `--superseded-by` (SPEC): for Superseded: the spec that supersedes it
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `spec show`
  - `spec` (SPEC): the spec
- `system add`
  - `--yes` (flag): do not ask: for a person who has read what --dry-run prints, and for CI
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `term list`
  - `--scheme` (SCHEME): only the concepts of this scheme
- `term show`
  - `term` (TERM): the term's local name
- `toolchain add`
  - `entries` (ENTRY, zero or more): the entries; every one with a build for this platform when none is named
  - `--dry-run` (flag): validate, write nothing, show the change
- `toolchain show`
  - `entry` (ENTRY): the entry

## Typed arguments

A value that fails its type is an error resource that names the type and gives examples.

| Type | Is | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BRAND` | a brand's slug: a design system with a brand.css (0014-design-systems FR-028) | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `CATEGORY` | a command category | read, check, record, build, generate, decision, setup |
| `COMMAND` | a command's words, as `command list` shows them | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `COMMIT` | a full Git commit, 40 hex digits | 8efca19779828488b21619777e5f7805ca22c2bb |
| `CONTROL` | a control as <catalog>:<control>, as the ontology's control catalogs declare them | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `COURSE_TARGET` | what a course is built to: a static site, an Open edX export or a cmi5 package | web, olx, cmi5 |
| `DATE` | a date as YYYY-MM-DD | 2026-10-04 |
| `DESIGN_SYSTEM` | a design system's slug, a directory of design-systems/ | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `ENTRY` | a toolchain entry, as `toolchain list` names them: tinytex, chromium, ... | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `GENERATOR` | a generator, as `fresh` proves it: brand-theme, brand-specimen, ... | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `GROUP` | a command group | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `INK` | an ink of a brand's decoration kit as <brand>/<role>, such as frontiers-brand/primary | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `KIND` | a design system kind code of the ontology's kind scheme, such as web or brand | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `KIT_PART` | which part of the decoration kit: trace (the lockup and icon) or set (the wordmark and unit marks) | trace, set |
| `LAYOUT` | a print layout's name or alias, from layouts.json: two-column, nature, jama | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `MECHANISM` | how a requirement is enforced (0020 FR-012) | check, gate, review, none |
| `PATH` | a path to a file or directory that exists, relative to where the command runs | design-systems/frontiers-slides/assurance/fixtures/pass/deck.md |
| `PIECE` | an imagery piece as <brand>/<piece>, such as frontiers-brand/fog-coast-lighthouse-footbridge | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `PROPOSAL` | a proposal as NNNN-slug, as `proposal list` shows them | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `PROPOSAL_STATUS` | whether a proposal is open or accepted | open, accepted |
| `REQUIREMENT` | a requirement as <spec>/FR-NNN, such as 0020/FR-013 | 0020/FR-013, 0041-command-line/FR-008 |
| `RESOURCE` | a resource as kind:id, such as spec:0020 or requirement:0020/FR-013 | spec:0020, requirement:0020/FR-013 |
| `RUNNER` | which harness: browser or python for design-systems; node or vscode for extension | browser, python, node, vscode |
| `SCHEME` | a concept scheme of the ontology by its local name, such as CommandCategoryScheme | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `SECTION` | a check section, as `command show check` lists them | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `SLUG` | lowercase words joined by hyphens | agora, command-line |
| `SPEC` | a spec as NNNN-slug or NNNN, or a design system's slug | 0020, 0020-spec-format, frontiers-brand |
| `SPEC_STATUS` | a spec's status (0020 FR-009) | Draft, Adopted, Superseded |
| `SUITE` | a named set of check sections | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `TERM` | a concept or scheme of the ontology by its local name, such as ReadCommandCategory | ReadCommandCategory, CommandCategoryScheme |
| `TOPIC` | a help topic, as `help` lists them: start, check, specs, ... | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `VARIANT` | a figure color variant of frontiers-figures: default, on-dark or grayscale | a value `<noun> list` or `--complete` offers |
| `VOICE_MODE` | how the voice sweep reads a text: as prose or as a procedure's steps | prose, procedure |

## Checks

Every check runs through `agora check [SECTION...] [--scope ID] [--suite SUITE] [--changed]`; `--changed` runs only the sections whose watched paths Git reports changed. With nothing named it runs every section. `agora fresh [GENERATOR...]` proves generated files current and writes nothing; `agora test` runs agora's own tests; `agora doctor` reports what is present and what is missing.

| Section | Checks | Scope | Suites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | The registry and the ontology list the same commands, with the same noun, verb and category (0042-agora FR-004) | none | `spec` |
| `controls` | The control map: each row names a requirement and a control (0028 FR-005, FR-006) | none | `spec` |
| `course` | Courses against frontiers-course's rules: outcomes taught and assessed, accessibility, limits, voice (course.py check) | PATH | none |
| `design-systems` | Each design system's assurance harness: browser harnesses under every brand, Python harnesses once; fails where a design system has none (0014 FR-015, FR-017, FR-039) | DESIGN_SYSTEM | `browser`, `python` |
| `email` | Messages against frontiers-email's rules: subject, preheader, one button, https links, address, voice (mail.py check) | PATH | none |
| `extension` | The IF Console extension's manifest, contributions and activation, its code's lint (no network, telemetry or write; names no other repository's tool), its unit tests under node's test runner, and its tests in a real VS Code under a display server (0043-if-console FR-028, FR-032) | none | `extension`, `vscode` |
| `figures` | Figure sources against frontiers-figures' mechanical rules: canvas, role colors, label size, labels inside their boxes (figcheck.py) | PATH | none |
| `help` | Every help topic is well formed, its steps are actions of the registry, and it names only commands, topics and paths that exist (0042 FR-033; 0041 FR-065) | none | `spec` |
| `imagery` | Each brand's imagery pool and share card: catalog, masters, WebP files, app icons (0014 FR-037, FR-043) | BRAND | `images` |
| `media` | Media jobs against frontiers-media's rules: format, safe margin, title fit, lockup, voice (media.py check) | PATH | none |
| `merchandise` | Decoration jobs against frontiers-merchandise's rules and a brand's decoration kit (decoration.py) | PATH | none |
| `ontology` | Ontology prefixes, and the design systems' registration, classification and derivation (0001 FR-007; 0014 FR-003, FR-010, FR-020) | none | `spec` |
| `openedx` | A brand's Open edX package is what is written from its tokens, and, with Paragon, what it builds, every pair 4.5:1 (frontiers-brand FR-020) | BRAND | `browser` |
| `register` | The enforcement register: one row per requirement, mechanism, command (0020 FR-011 to FR-014) | SPEC | `spec` |
| `signage` | Sign jobs against frontiers-signage-print's rules: format, details, imagery resolution, voice (signage.py check) | PATH | none |
| `slides` | Decks against frontiers-slides' rules: layouts, headlines, points, notes, figures, voice (deck.py check) | PATH | none |
| `specs` | Spec format: sections, status, identity, numbering, dated provenance, cross-references (0020 FR-005 to FR-009, FR-018; 0001 FR-034) | SPEC | `spec` |
| `toolchain` | The toolchain lock is complete, https, pinned and hashed; no workflow installs a program, and nothing requires a host program or a workspace (0041-command-line FR-068; 0025-tooling-environment FR-016, FR-020, FR-022, FR-025) | none | `spec` |
| `voice` | Prose against frontiers-written-voice's sweep, or with --spoken a script against frontiers-spoken-voice's too (sweep.py) | PATH | none |

## Generators

A generated file carries a header naming its generator and must not be edited by hand; rewrite it with the command shown.

| Generator | Writes | Rewritten by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent-skill` | The agent skill, .claude/skills/agora/SKILL.md, from the registry (0041-command-line FR-037) | `agora skill generate` |
| `brand-decoration` | A brand's decoration kit: the traced lockup and icon, the set wordmark and unit marks, and their measured finest detail in tokens.json | `agora decoration generate` |
| `brand-imagery` | A brand's WebP files, share card, app icons and favicon, from its masters and tokens | `agora imagery build` |
| `brand-specimen` | A brand's assurance specimen, from its tokens.json | `agora brand generate` |
| `brand-theme` | A brand's brand.css and brand.tex, from its tokens.json | `agora brand generate` |
| `openedx-sources` | A brand's Open edX package sources (everything but the built dist/), from its tokens.json, logos and fonts | `agora openedx generate` |
| `print-layout-docs` | The print design system's layout and typeface catalogs inside its Markdown, from latex/layouts.json and latex/typefaces.json | `agora ` |
| `profile-figure` | The organization profile's figure: its semantic source and the themed default and on-dark images | `agora figure generate` |
| `reference-docs` | The guide's reference chapters: commands, checks, help topics, toolchain, design systems and specs | `agora docs generate` |

## MCP

`agora mcp serve` speaks MCP over standard input and output. It lists these 55 commands as tools, named with spaces made underscores (`spec_show`, `check`), each taking the arguments above by name; a tool that writes takes `dry_run`, which is true unless you pass false. A `decision` command is never a tool and a call to one is refused with the error resource `decision-refused`, whose next action is `proposal new`. Resources are readable by URI: `agora://spec/ID`, `agora://requirement/SPEC/FR-NNN`, `agora://design-system/SLUG`, `agora://brand/SLUG`, `agora://term/ID`, `agora://command/WORDS`, `agora://proposal/ID`, `agora://context/KIND:ID`.
